summary: An OpenAI-compatible model provider that refuses any address off this machine, turns every failure into a value, keeps describe() synchronous for the render path, and routes every AI log line through the secret scanner (H1 + H6)

coordination.notes: Extends the existing owners rather than adding siblings. The provider implements the ModelProvider interface aiModelProvider.ts already defines and adds no second one; the secret redactor is built from that module's own SECRET_PATTERNS rather than a private copy, because two lists answering one question drift and the half nobody re-reads is the half that leaks. aiLog is added there for the same reason and has a live caller in this commit (the think-retry notice), so it is not a scaffold. It touches nothing Lane G or Lane E holds: AiWorkerPanel.tsx and SettingsSheet.tsx are untouched by this increment. The one edit to another lane's test is A8's panel guard, whose property is unchanged and whose measured thing moved from a file existing to the host importing it. H6 lands here rather than in its own commit because this is the first module in src/lib with anything to log, and a redactor with no caller is exactly the scaffold AGENTS.md forbids. Rebased onto 19458ecf after Lane D merged and removed its own register row; my row is added below Lane B's rather than reinstating one its owner deleted.

checks: npm run test:ai-local-provider: 77 checked, 0 failed, all passed
decisive: 'a remote server that WOULD answer is still never contacted' with an injected fetch that records every call and returns a valid models list
decisive control: 'control: the same recorder does see a loopback request  http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1/models' - so a zero call count above is a refusal, not a broken recorder

verify per the plan: models list -> available (profile qwen3:4b-instruct); 500 'CUDA error: out of memory' -> out_of_memory; 200 HTML -> invalid_output; JSON with empty choices -> invalid_output; abort mid-request -> cancelled; remote host -> refused naming the host and 'Nothing was sent'

sabotage: `if (false && !options.allowRemote && !isLoopbackHost(parsed.hostname))` -> 72 checked, 5 failed, including 'so it cannot be reported as ready  somebody-elses-model' and 'and generating against it sends nothing  2'; restored, md5 2b0e482e81da7a904b4f28ad5c4475f9 either side

the first sabotage attempt produced only 2 failures and was rejected as too weak: against an unreachable remote address a dropped host check fails as ordinary absence and is indistinguishable from a refusal. The two decisive checks exist because of that, not before it.

Ollama is NOT installed on this machine, so the plan's instruction to record the installed version's thinking switch could not be followed: Get-Command ollama finds nothing; a recursive C:\ search for ollama*.exe returns nothing while the same search finds node.exe (positive control); ~/.ollama/models is empty; nothing listens on 11434. The flag is self-correcting instead of guessed - a 400 mentioning 'think' is retried once without it, and that retry is a tested case.
